sloka: तौ तु क्रूरेण निहतौ रक्षसा कामरूपिणा ।असृक् सुस्रुवतुस्तीव्रं जलं प्रस्रवणाविव ।। ६.४५.२१ ।।।।
transliteration: tau tu krūreṇa nihatau rakṣasā kāmarūpiṇā ।asṛk susruvatustīvraṁ jalaṁ prasravaṇāviva ।। 6.45.21 ।।।।

translations.english: Wounded by the cruel Rakshasas capable of changing form at their will, blood flowed from their body copiously like water from spring bringing out their vital life breaths.
